statement: SDL Xbox360 HIDAPI sends wired rumble as 8-byte 00 08 00 strong weak 00 00 00 using high magnitude bytes and slot LED as 01 03 <mode>; generic trigger rumble unsupported. The newer revision additionally includes a Steam virtual gamepad special output path.
